title: Graph Cutting
statementMd:
Little Chris is participating in a graph cutting contest. He's a pro. The time has come to test his skills to the fullest.

Chris is given a simple undirected connected graph with $*n*$ vertices (numbered from 1 to $*n*$) and $*m*$ edges. The problem is to cut it into edge-distinct paths of length 2. Formally, Chris has to partition all edges of the graph into pairs in such a way that the edges in a single pair are adjacent and each edge must be contained in exactly one pair.

For example, the figure shows a way Chris can cut a graph. The first sample test contains the description of this graph.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1931ff06c3c5669ead3c804c6f0b78089ef690ce.png)

You are given a chance to compete with Chris. Find a way to cut the given graph or determine that it is impossible!

## Input

The first line of input contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$), the number of vertices and the number of edges in the graph. The next $*m*$ lines contain the description of the graph's edges. The $*i*$-th line contains two space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$; $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$), the numbers of the vertices connected by the $*i*$-th edge. It is guaranteed that the given graph is simple (without self-loops and multi-edges) and connected.

**Note**: since the size of the input and output could be very large, don't use slow output techniques in your language. For example, do not use input and output streams (cin, cout) in C++.

## Output

If it is possible to cut the given graph into edge-distinct paths of length 2, output ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2433a7a8dcdc8aa2ad7a976baa8327b6529431e1.png) lines. In the $*i*$-th line print three space-separated integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ and $*z*_{*i*}$, the description of the $*i*$-th path. The graph should contain this path, i.e., the graph should contain edges $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ and $(*y*_{*i*}, *z*_{*i*})$. Each edge should appear in exactly one path of length 2. If there are multiple solutions, output any of them.

If it is impossible to cut the given graph, print `"No solution"` (without quotes).
statementZhMd:
<statement>
小 Chris 正在参加一场图切割竞赛。他是这方面的专家。现在，是时候让他充分展示自己的实力了。

给定一个有 $*n*$ 个顶点（编号从 1 到 $*n*$）和 $*m*$ 条边的简单无向连通图。问题是将其切分为若干条边互不相同的长度为 2 的路径。形式化地说，Chris 需要将图中的所有边划分成若干对，使得同一对中的两条边相邻，并且每条边恰好属于一对。

例如，图中展示了一种 Chris 切割图的方法。第一个样例描述的就是这张图。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1931ff06c3c5669ead3c804c6f0b78089ef690ce.png)

现在给你一个与 Chris 竞争的机会。请找出一种切割给定图的方法，或者判断这是不可能的！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$），分别表示顶点数和边数。接下来的 $*m*$ 行描述图中的边。第 $*i*$ 行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$；$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示第 $*i*$ 条边所连接的两个顶点。保证给定的图是简单图（没有自环和重边）且连通。

**说明**：由于输入和输出规模可能非常大，请不要在所使用的语言中采用低效的输出方式。例如，在 C++ 中不要使用输入输出流（cin、cout）。

## 输出格式

如果可以将给定的图切分为边互不相同的长度为 2 的路径，请输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2433a7a8dcdc8aa2ad7a976baa8327b6529431e.png) 行。第 $*i*$ 行输出三个用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*i*}$、$*y*_{*i*}$ 和 $*z*_{*i*}$，表示第 $*i*$ 条路径。图中必须包含这条路径，即图中必须包含边 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ 和 $(*y*_{*i*}, *z*_{*i*})$。每条边都必须恰好出现在一条长度为 2 的路径中。如果有多种解，输出任意一种即可。

如果无法切割给定的图，输出 `No solution`（不含引号）。
</statement>
